name: Survival Subdomain
body:
Associated Domain: Hunting

Replacement Power: The following granted power replaces the hunting companion power of the Hunting domain.

Elemental Adaption (Su)

At 4th level, you are constantly under the effects of the endure elements spell. Additionally, you may increase the effect of this spell to provide the benefits of life bubble for a number of hours equal to your class level. The hours need not be consecutive but must be used in 1 hour increments.

Domain Spells

1st–endure elements, 4th–life bubble, 9th–foresight
